name: tr_tjd
caption:
IF TRAYCE JACKSON-DAVIS WAS A POKÉMON TRAINER, THIS IS HIS TEAM 🎮🏀

🛡️ Bastiodon, the wall: Indiana's all-time leader in blocks (270) and rebounds (1,143)
🔥 Magmortar, the cannon: 43 points vs Marshall, Indiana's first 40-point game in 27 years
💪 Machamp, the power forward: Karl Malone Award, the nation's top power forward
🪙 Gholdengo, sold for cash: pick 57, Washington sold his rights for cash
⚡ Electivire, the jolt: 10 points and 10 rebounds in 15 minutes in his debut for us, 5th ever in our history
🦏 Rhyperior, the ace: 71.4% shooting through 8 games

Which one would you add? 👇

facts.claim: Finished his Indiana career as the program's all-time leader in rebounds (1,143) and blocked shots (270); November 27, 2021: career-high 43 points vs Marshall, first (1st) Indiana player to score at least 40 points in 27 years; awarded the Karl Malone Award for the nation's top power forward; drafted 57th overall (#57) in 2023, the pick held by Washington, who traded his rights for cash considerations; Raptors debut: 10 points and 10 rebounds in 15 minutes, fifth (5th) player in franchise history with a double-double in their debut
